evals.prompt: Review this Angular dialog for accessibility. It opens on click, has an icon-only close button, and shows validation errors below the form fields.
evals.expected_output: Checks keyboard operation, accessible naming, focus management, Escape handling, and aria-invalid/aria-describedby associations.

evals.prompt: Make the Oblique master layout accessible for keyboard and screen-reader users.
evals.expected_output: Applies WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented cross-cutting rules and reads the relevant component reference.

evals.prompt: Reduce the bundle size of an Angular service that has no UI, focus, forms, or accessibility behavior.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate accessibility guidance unless the implementation introduces a user-facing interaction.
